items.name: TryInitError
items.summary: Error returned by [`try_init`](SubscriberInitExt::try_init) if a global default subscriber could not be initialized.

items.name: SubscriberInitExt
items.summary: Extension trait adding utility methods for subscriber initialization.

methods.name: init
methods.summary: Attempts to set `self` as the [global default subscriber] in the current scope, panicking if this fails.

methods.name: set_default
methods.summary: Sets `self` as the [default subscriber] in the current scope, returning a guard that will unset it when dropped.

methods.name: try_init
methods.summary: Attempts to set `self` as the [global default subscriber] in the current scope, returning an error if one is already set.
